basic_details.job_title: IIG Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Geomagnetism (IIG), an autonomous body under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India, will take online applications for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF)/Project Associate-I post in an ANRF-sponsored project, from 25 November 2026 to 14 December 2026. The post needs an M.Sc. in Physics or a B.S.-M.S. (5-year Integrated) in Physics with First Class. The fellowship is Rs. 37,000 + HRA for candidates selected through CSIR-UGC NET or GATE, and Rs. 30,000 + HRA for others. The initial tenure is 01 year, and the work is at IIG Headquarters, New Panvel.

age_limit.details: The maximum age is 30 years as on the last date of submission of online application. The notice does not mention an age relaxation.

qualification.details: M.Sc. in Physics, or B.S.-M.S. (5-year Integrated) in Physics, with First Class. On production of valid certificates issued by a competent authority, a relaxation of 5% marks or its equivalent grade is allowed to those belonging to SC/ST/OBC (non-creamy layer)/PwBD/Economically Weaker Section (EWS), as per the notification issued by UGC from time to time.

how_to_apply: The notice asks candidates to submit the application through online mode. For more information, candidates may visit the Institute website, http://www.iigm.res.in/careers/. Online applications start on 25 November 2026 and the last date of submission is 14 December 2026. The notice does not name documents to be attached.

content_sections.heading: About IIG
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Geomagnetism is an autonomous research institute under the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India. It works in Geomagnetism and allied fields and has experimental and high-performance computing facilities. It also offers a Doctoral Programme in Geomagnetism and Allied Fields covering Solid Earth, Space Weather, Upper Atmospheric / Ionospheric Physics and Space Plasma Physics. Its address is Plot No.5, Sector-18, Kalamboli Highway, New Panvel, Navi Mumbai – 410 218.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: M.Sc. in Physics, or B.S.-M.S. (5-year Integrated) in Physics, with First Class. On production of valid certificates issued by a competent authority, a relaxation of 5% marks or its equivalent grade is allowed to those belonging to SC/ST/OBC (non-creamy layer)/PwBD/Economically Weaker Section (EWS), as per the notification issued by UGC from time to time. Experience in satellite data analysis. Programming in Matlab/C/C++/IDL/Python. The maximum age is 30 years as on the last date of submission of online application. The notice does not mention an age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship will be revised as per ANRF rules. The tenure is initially 01 year. Renewals are for up to 02 years, based on satisfactory performance each year and availability of funds, and are co-terminus with the duration of the project.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates fulfilling the prescribed eligibility criteria will be shortlisted and called for an interview. The final selection will be based on the candidate's performance in the interview. The notice does not give the interview date or mode.
